name: Apprenticeship at Randstad Digital
shortDescription: Completed a 3-year apprenticeship in Bavaria, mastering Java backend and Angular frontend development.

name: Customer Project – Automotive
shortDescription: Backend-focused role on a large automotive project over more than three years — from on-premise operation through migration to the AWS cloud to running it on AWS, with additional frontend work.
fullDescription:
The system calculates precise CO2 and emission values for vehicles based on specific parameters. A central data service makes these results available to other systems in a uniform way, while a dedicated monitoring and reporting module generates standard-compliant vehicle documents.

My focus was on backend development, complemented by frontend and cloud work:
• Developed Java backend features (main focus)
• Defined and connected interfaces with OpenAPI
• Modelled and processed data in an Oracle database
• Took on Angular frontend tasks
• Operated and extended the application on-premise at first
• Supported the migration of the application to the AWS cloud
• Deployed features on AWS and ran them with the operating team
• Built custom monitoring dashboards (CloudWatch)
• Analysed and fixed bugs to improve system stability
• Provided 2nd- and 3rd-level support for complex issues

name: AWS Certified: Cloud Practitioner
shortDescription: Earned the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner credential, demonstrating foundational knowledge of AWS services.

name: Personal website
shortDescription: Developed a personal website using Angular to showcase projects and professional profile.
fullDescription:
This personal website utilizes Angular, Tailwind CSS, and Vercel to deliver a comprehensive project portfolio. 
Through this project, I advanced my front-end development capabilities and deepened my understanding of contemporary web development practices.

name: Customer Project – Finance
shortDescription: Full-stack role on a finance project, frontend and backend alike, modernizing legacy applications into a unified web platform.
fullDescription:
The project modernizes an outdated software landscape in the finance sector by moving to a web-based architecture. Several specialist applications were consolidated into a shared monorepo and rebuilt as a modern, user-friendly web interface for structured data entry.

I work on the frontend and backend alike, delivering features across the whole stack:
• Delivered features end to end from backend to frontend
• Defined and connected interfaces with OpenAPI
• Built data models and persistence with MongoDB
• Developed backend logic in Java and Spring
• Built the Angular frontend for structured data entry
• Improved the UI and usability with UX design
• Implemented import and export functionality
• Tested the frontend and its interfaces, wrote unit tests
• Documented functional and technical changes
